transkript.t: You can now tell Claude to build a game-ready 3D crate in Blender.
So someone packed 22 Blender skills into one free GitHub repo, from modeling to rigging.
Because each skill is a plain instruction file, Claude knows how to bake normals and set up LODs.
Then, it runs Blender in the background and exports the crate for Unity or Unreal.
So you don't need Blender's menus, because Claude drives the real app.
For the repo link, comment crate.
